about_the_game:
Dinosaur Zoo – VR Survival Shooter

Step into Dinosaur Zoo, the ultimate VR dinosaur survival shooter where every step could be your last. Dinosaur Zoo is a story-driven shooting adventure that pulls you right into the action.

Your Mission

You play as a skilled hunter trapped in a world where dinosaurs never went extinct. They’re massive, wild, and always one step away from turning you into lunch.

From massive carnivores to fast, aggressive raptors, including the T-Rex, Dilophosaurus, and Dimetrodon, every corner hides a threat. Your mission: stay alive, save stranded survivors, and bring order back before it’s too late.

Next-Level Realism

The dinosaurs in Dinosaur Zoo are more than visuals they think, react, and hunt like real predators.

Survival. Hunting. Action.

Immersive VR Combat: Use powerful, realistic weapons built for precise VR gameplay.

Exploration & Rescue: Explore vast zoo areas, uncover hidden paths, and rescue survivors.

Dynamic Dino Encounters: Face intelligent predators that stalk, chase, and strike without warning.

Perfect for fans of dinosaur hunting, VR shooters, and survival action, Dinosaur Zoo delivers intense moments, stunning environments, and unforgettable virtual reality battles.

The ultimate VR dinosaur zoo adventure starts now.

legal_notice:
Subject: Clarification on Assets, Copyright, and Proof of Purchases for Jurassic Zoo: Dinosaur Hunting

Dear Steam Review Team,

Thank you for reviewing my game submission. I would like to clarify and provide proof regarding the assets, copyrights, and originality of my project Jurassic Zoo: Dinosaur Hunting.

3D Models & Assets

All dinosaur and human models used in my game were legally purchased from marketplaces (examples attached: Pterosaur, Dimetrodon, Dilophosaurus, Jurassic Carnivore Collection, Tyrannosaurus Rex, etc.).

Fiverr Orders & Profile
If you require, I can also provide all Fiverr order receipts and completed project files to further verify ownership.

My Fiverr Buyer Profile: https://www.fiverr.com/daniyal360

Some custom assets (humans, and environments) were created specifically for my game by a professional Fiverr seller Qasim Khursheed, who is a 3D modeler, animator, and environment artist.

Fiverr Profile: https://www.fiverr.com/cgartistustc?source=order_page_summary_seller_link

Voice Over & Sound Design

Voice overs were professionally recorded by Andrew Helbig.

Fiverr Profile: https://www.fiverr.com/andrewhelbig?source=order_page_summary_seller_link

Sound and music were created by Chamith S (Decibel_DB).

Fiverr Profile: https://www.fiverr.com/decibel_db?source=order_page_summary_seller_link

Game Logo & Branding

The logo featuring a roaring dinosaur silhouette was custom-made by my Fiverr 3D artist. The dinosaur depicted is a Spinosaurus, not directly referencing copyrighted Jurassic Park/World assets.

The font used is a free font that is not affiliated with or copyrighted by the Jurassic Park franchise.

Use of the Word “Jurassic”

The standalone word “Jurassic” refers to the geologic time period and is not copyrighted or trademarked.

Only full phrases like “Jurassic Park” or “Jurassic World” are registered trademarks. My game title “Jurassic Zoo: Dinosaur Hunting” does not infringe on these.

Proof of Authenticity
I have already published this game on major platforms that enforce strict copyright and trademark compliance checks:

Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dinosaur-hunting-jurassic-zone/id6587583403

Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.canadianrig.jurassiczoo&hl=en

Meta Quest Store: https://www.meta.com/experiences/jurassic-zoo-dinosaur-hunting/29675103538805002

(if the page does not open due to regional or login restrictions, I can provide screenshots from my developer console confirming the live status)


Request for Clarification
If there is any element you believe may infringe on copyright or trademark, kindly provide details or screenshots so I can address and correct them immediately.

I respectfully request approval for my game to be published on Steam. I am fully committed to resolving any concerns and ensuring compliance with Steam’s content guidelines.

Thank you for your time and support.

Best regards,
Daniyal Gohar

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest (via Link/Air Link), Oculus Rift, HTC Vive, Valve Index

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest (via Link/Air Link), Oculus Rift, HTC Vive, Valve Index
